hx_gen_parallel_contour — 2D halcon_ext op

• Data kinds: contour → contour

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "hx_gen_parallel_contour", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: gen_parallel_contour_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Generate the parallel (normal-offset) contour of each contour (the signed distance comes from (a−0.5)).
